tools.name: get_qa_tech_page_markdown
tools.description: Fetch the markdown version of any qa.tech page. Every indexable page has a markdown twin at the same path with '.md' appended.

path.description: Site path or full URL, e.g. '/blog/what-is-agentic-testing' or 'https://qa.tech/pricing'.

tools.name: list_qa_tech_pages
tools.description: List indexable qa.tech pages, optionally filtered by path prefix such as '/blog', '/case-studies', '/compare' or '/changelog'.

limit.description: Maximum number of paths to return (default 50).

tools.name: open_qa_tech_page
tools.description: Navigate the current browser tab to a qa.tech page, for example '/demo' to book a demo, '/pricing', or a specific blog post.

tools.name: search_qa_tech
tools.description: Search qa.tech content (product pages, blog posts, case studies, comparisons, changelog) by keyword. Returns matching page URLs with the matching text snippets.

query.description: Keywords to search for, e.g. 'pull request testing'.

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to return (default 8).
